ordered.title: The misconception that costs owners thousands

blocks.text: "Main dealers are more expensive but better quality."
Main dealers are more expensive - but not necessarily better quality for engine replacement. Independent specialists often have more experienced technicians on complex engine work.

Why independent specialists often deliver better value: • More experienced technicians - specialists work on the same engines every day • Better value parts - reconditioned and remanufactured options vs expensive new OEM • Faster turnaround - less bureaucracy, more flexibility • Direct supplier relationships - access to the same reconditioned engine network • Fixed-fee pricing - no surprise labour hours
Real-world example: BMW N47 timing chain replacement
💰 BMW N47 Timing Chain Replacement - Cost Comparison

"In real UK workshop practice, independent specialists often have more experienced technicians on complex engine work than main dealers - because they do it every day. The main dealer premium (£500-£4,000+) reflects brand overhead, not superior quality."
